cards.headline:
DeepMind 월드 모델
Genie 4 실시간 세계
cards.body: Genie 4는 소리와 Gemini-powered 조종으로 실시간 세계를 빚는다.

blocks.x: Google DeepMind가 새 월드 모델 Genie 4를 발표했다. 사실감을 전례 없는 수준으로 끌어올렸고 실시간 인터랙티브 시뮬레이션도 개선했다. Genie 4는 네이티브 멀티모달 모델이라 음악과 주변 소음, 인터랙티브 대화 같은 오디오를 세계와 함께 생성한다.
바탕은 Gemini 계열의 역량이다. Gemini Omni가 시뮬레이션을 실제 세계의 외형과 움직임에 맞추고, 일관성과 연속성을 지키는 데 필요한 복잡한 추론은 다른 Gemini 모델들이 맡는다.
Genie 4에서는 자연어만으로 시뮬레이션을 실시간으로 고친다. 날씨를 바꾸고 카메라를 움직이고 새 인물이나 사물을 등장시키는 식이다. 세계의 물리를 깊이 이해하는 덕분에 공기역학이나 충돌 같은 상황도 시뮬레이션하며, 자연스럽게 움직이고 실시간으로 조종되는 캐릭터도 만든다.
루프 안에서는 Gemini 3.8 Flash가 안내 에이전트를 맡아 장면을 관찰하고 목표를 단계로 나눈 뒤 단계마다 검증한다. Genie 4가 만드는 영상과 오디오에는 빠짐없이 SynthID 워터마크가 들어간다.
Genie 4는 신뢰할 수 있는 테스터에게 리서치 프리뷰로 먼저 풀렸다. 곧 Project Genie의 Google AI Ultra 구독자와 Gemini API·Google AI Studio의 얼리 액세스 파트너도 쓸 수 있다.

en.headline:
DeepMind's Genie 4 simulates
interactive worlds in real time
en.body: Genie 4 adds real-time interactive world simulation with native audio, advanced physics, and Gemini-powered steering.
en.mini_headline:
Genie 4 simulates
worlds in real time

blocks.x: Google DeepMind is announcing Genie 4, its new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation. Genie 4 is natively multimodal, enabling audio-like music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue to be simultaneously generated with the world.

The model builds on capabilities from the Gemini family: Gemini Omni anchors the simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, while other Gemini models provide the complex reasoning needed to maintain a simulation's coherence and continuity.

With Genie 4, users can use natural language to modify a simulation in real-time — like changing the weather, moving the camera, or introducing a new person or object. Built on an advanced physical understanding of the world, it simulates scenarios such as aerodynamics and collisions, and creates characters that move naturally and can be steered in real-time.

Gemini 3.8 Flash serves as a guiding agent in the loop, observing the scene, breaking goals into steps and verifying each one. All video and audio generated by Genie 4 will include SynthID watermarking.

Genie 4 has been released as a research preview to trusted testers, and is coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

ja.headline:
DeepMindの世界モデル
Genie 4は実時間で動く
ja.body: Genie 4は音声と物理演算、Gemini-poweredの操作で実時間の世界を描く。

blocks.x: Google DeepMindは新たな世界モデルGenie 4を発表した。かつてないリアリズムを実現し、リアルタイムのインタラクティブなシミュレーションを向上させるモデルだ。Genie 4はネイティブにマルチモーダルで、音楽や環境音、インタラクティブな対話といった音声を世界と同時に生成できる。
このモデルはGeminiファミリーの能力を基盤とする。Gemini Omniがシミュレーションを現実世界の見た目と振る舞いに結びつけ、他のGeminiモデルがシミュレーションの一貫性と連続性を保つのに必要な複雑な推論を担う。
Genie 4では、天候を変える、カメラを動かす、新たな人物や物体を登場させるといった形で、自然言語を使ってシミュレーションをリアルタイムに変更できる。世界に対する高度な物理的理解に基づき、空気力学や衝突などのシナリオをシミュレートし、自然に動いてリアルタイムに操作できるキャラクターを生み出す。
Gemini 3.8 Flashはループ内の誘導エージェントとして機能し、シーンを観察し、目標をステップに分解して一つずつ検証する。Genie 4が生成するすべての映像と音声にはSynthIDの透かしが入る。
Genie 4は信頼できるテスター向けにリサーチプレビューとして公開されており、まもなくProject GenieのGoogle AI Ultra加入者と、Gemini APIおよびGoogle AI Studioのアーリーアクセスパートナーに提供される。

zh.headline:
DeepMind新世界模型
Genie 4实时模拟世界
zh.body: Genie 4具备原生音频、先进物理和Gemini-powered操控，实时模拟交互世界。

blocks.x: Google DeepMind发布新世界模型Genie 4，带来前所未有的真实感，并改进了实时交互式模拟。Genie 4原生支持多模态，可与世界同步生成音乐、环境音和交互式对话等音频。
该模型建立在Gemini系列的能力之上：Gemini Omni让模拟贴合真实世界的外观与行为，其他Gemini模型则提供维持模拟连贯性与连续性所需的复杂推理。
借助Genie 4，用户可以用自然语言实时修改模拟，比如改变天气、移动镜头，或引入新的人物或物体。它基于对世界的高级物理理解，可模拟空气动力学和碰撞等场景，并生成动作自然、可实时操控的角色。
Gemini 3.8 Flash在循环中充当引导智能体，观察场景、将目标拆解为步骤并逐一验证。Genie 4生成的所有视频和音频都将带有SynthID水印。
Genie 4已作为研究预览版向受信任的测试者开放，即将面向Project Genie中的Google AI Ultra订阅用户，以及Gemini API和Google AI Studio的早期访问合作伙伴推出。

es.headline:
DeepMind: Genie 4 simula mundos
interactivos en tiempo real
es.body: Genie 4 añade simulación interactiva de mundos en tiempo real, audio nativo, física avanzada y control Gemini-powered.
es.mini_headline: Genie 4 simula mundos en tiempo real

blocks.x: Google DeepMind anuncia Genie 4, su nuevo modelo de mundo, que ofrece un realismo sin precedentes y mejora la simulación interactiva en tiempo real. Genie 4 es multimodal de forma nativa, lo que permite generar audio —como música, ruido ambiental y diálogo interactivo— de manera simultánea con el mundo.

El modelo se basa en capacidades de la familia Gemini: Gemini Omni ancla las simulaciones en la apariencia y el comportamiento del mundo real, mientras que otros modelos Gemini aportan el razonamiento complejo necesario para mantener la coherencia y la continuidad de la simulación.

Con Genie 4, los usuarios pueden usar lenguaje natural para modificar una simulación en tiempo real, por ejemplo cambiando el clima, moviendo la cámara o introduciendo una nueva persona u objeto. Gracias a una comprensión física avanzada del mundo, simula escenarios como la aerodinámica y las colisiones, y crea personajes que se mueven con naturalidad y pueden dirigirse en tiempo real.

Gemini 3.8 Flash actúa como agente guía dentro del ciclo: observa la escena, divide los objetivos en pasos y verifica cada uno. Todo el video y el audio generados por Genie 4 incluirán la marca de agua SynthID.

Genie 4 se ha lanzado como versión preliminar de investigación para probadores de confianza y pronto llegará a los suscriptores de Google AI Ultra en Project Genie y a los socios de acceso anticipado en la Gemini API y Google AI Studio.

cards.headline:
Epic EULA, AI
학습에 Unreal 개방
cards.body: Sweeney는 Unreal 산출물의 AI 학습을 EULA로 풀어 주겠다고 했다.
cards.mini_headline: Epic EULA, Unreal AI 학습 허용

blocks.x: Epic CEO Tim Sweeney가 X에 올린 글을 보면, Epic은 Unreal Engine과 MetaHuman 산출물의 AI 학습 제한을 없애는 중이고 EULA도 곧 바뀐다.
지난 26일 Kotaku는 Microsoft와 Epic 같은 기업이 AI에 사활을 걸면서도 사용자가 만든 AI-coded 자사 게임 재현작은 내리게 한다며 잠재적 위선을 짚었다. Sweeney는 여기에 긴 답글을 달다가 EULA 업데이트 계획을 지나가듯 꺼냈다.
"Epic은 Unreal Engine과 MetaHuman 산출물의 AI 학습을 제한하는가?" Sweeney는 이렇게 쓴 뒤 말을 이었다. "현재는 그렇다. 하지만 EULA 조항에서 이 제한을 없애려 하고 있다. 다만 이 도구들을 쓰는 각 게임은 개발자가 고른 조건으로 출시되며, 그 조건은 AI 학습을 허용할 수도 제한할 수도 있다."
AI 학습에 엔진을 일절 쓰지 못하게 하던 Unreal Engine으로서는 뚜렷한 변화다. Epic은 스스로 "AI-first"라 부르는 모델로 옮겨 가는 중이다. Sweeney는 Valve가 Steam에서 요구하는 AI 사용 공개 의무를 비판한 적도 있다. Game Developer는 Epic에 추가 정보를 요청했다.

en.headline:
Epic's EULA will allow AI
training on Unreal output
en.body: Tim Sweeney says Epic's engine EULA will permit training AI on output made with Unreal Engine and MetaHuman.
en.mini_headline:
Epic EULA opens
Unreal to AI training

blocks.x: Epic's EULA will be changing in the future as the company works to remove restrictions on training AI off the outputs from Unreal Engine and MetaHuman, according to a post on X from Epic CEO Tim Sweeney.

On October 26, Kotaku published a piece calling out the potential hypocrisy of companies like Microsoft and Epic going all-in on AI while shutting down user-made AI-coded recreations of their games. Sweeney responded with a long post in which he casually dropped news about the planned EULA update.

"Does Epic restrict AI training on outputs of Unreal Engine and MetaHuman?" Sweeney writes. "Yes currently but we are working to remove this restriction from EULA terms, though each game using these tools is released under terms of the developers' choosing which can allow or restrict AI training."

This is a marked change for Unreal Engine, which had previously not allowed any use of the engine for AI to train itself, as Epic shifts to what it calls an "AI-first" model. Sweeney has also criticized Valve's AI disclosure requirement on Steam. Game Developer has reached out to Epic for more information.

ja.body: SweeneyはEpicのEULAを改め、Unreal出力でのAI学習を認めると述べた。

blocks.x: Epic CEOのTim SweeneyがXに投稿した内容によると、同社はUnreal EngineとMetaHumanの出力をAI学習に使うことへの制限を撤廃する作業を進めており、EpicのEULAは今後変更される。
26日、Kotakuは、MicrosoftやEpicのような企業がAIに全力を注ぐ一方で、ユーザーが作ったAI-codedの自社ゲーム再現作品を閉鎖させているという潜在的な偽善を指摘する記事を掲載した。Sweeneyは長文の投稿で応じ、その中でEULA更新の計画をさらりと明かした。

cards.headline:

진짜 팬들을 밀어낸다
cards.body: 오류투성이 LLM-powered 게임 위키가 팬을 밀어내고 퍼블리셔까지 괴롭힌다.

blocks.x: Eurogamer 기자가 Nighthawks 정보를 찾다 들어간 "Nighthawks Wiki"는 위키라 부르기도 민망했다. 있지도 않은 동료와 스킬을 늘어놓는 등 틀린 정보투성이였다. 도메인을 따라가 보니 "AI Website builder"도 제공하는 웹사이트 제작 서비스 Spaceship이 나왔다.

blocks.cap: 문제의 비공식 Nighthawks 위키. | 이미지 출처: Eurogamer / Nighthawks.wiki

blocks.x: Hooded Horse CEO Tim Bender는 퍼블리셔 입장에서 AI-generated 사이트를 상대로 "두더지 잡기(whack-a-mole)"를 해야 했다고 말한다. "[생성형 AI] 덕분에 사실상 상업적인 업체들이 줄줄이 대량 생산에 나서 게임 검색 엔진 결과를 뒤덮고 트래픽을 빨아들이려 한다"는 것이다.
독립 위키도 AI 스크래퍼에 시달린다. Dune: Awakening Community Wiki에는 30일 동안 AI 크롤러 요청이 7m 건 들어왔고, 그중 5m 건이 Meta발이었다. Independent Game Wiki Network의 FlamingMojo에 따르면 서버 비용은 세 배에서 열 배까지 뛰었다.
"AI 오염에서 살아남는 길은 커뮤니티다." FlamingMojo의 말이다.

en.headline:
Error-ridden AI game wikis
are pushing real fans aside
en.body: LLM-powered game wikis full of errors are taking over, sidelining fans and leaving publishers playing whack-a-mole.
en.mini_headline:
AI game wikis
push fans aside

blocks.x: Searching for information on Nighthawks, Eurogamer's writer landed on a "Nighthawks Wiki" that wasn't a wiki at all and was full of false information, like listing companions and skills that don't exist. Its domain traced to a website building service called Spaceship, which also offers an "AI Website builder."

blocks.cap: The unofficial Nighthawks wiki in question. | Image credit: Eurogamer / Nighthawks.wiki

blocks.x: Hooded Horse CEO Tim Bender says the publisher has had to "play whack-a-mole" with AI-generated sites. "[Generative AI] enables a run of basically commercial enterprises to mass produce and try to flood the search engine results of games to soak up their traffic," he says.

Independent wikis also face AI scrapers: the Dune: Awakening Community Wiki saw 7m requests in 30 days from AI crawlers, 5m of them from Meta. FlamingMojo of the Independent Game Wiki Network says server costs have increased between three- and ten-fold.
"The way we survive the AI pollution is with community," says FlamingMojo.

en.headline:

en.body: Peter Molyneux says the industry pretends it isn't using AI, but that coding without it is now almost impossible.
en.mini_headline:
Molyneux: no coding
without AI now

blocks.x: PC Gamer interviewed Peter Molyneux, the developer behind Populous, Theme Park, Dungeon Keeper, Black & White and Fable, in Guildford and asked about AI use in the video game industry.

He blamed ChatGPT and Gemini for locking "AI equals AI slop" into people's minds, and said ticking Steam's AI box means "instantly 12% [of gamers are] gone." "We as the industry are pretending we're not using AI, but the reality is, it's almost impossible to code now without using AI. Almost impossible."

He called AI "the biggest step forward in creativity" for studios: concepting work can be done in five minutes, and prototyping a fully rigged character rising from the ground is "all done in a day, not months."

"I don't think AI is powerful enough yet to trust it to produce the assets for the final quality of the game. But Rob, it will be." Within a year, he predicts AI will be so bound to middleware like Unity and Unreal that it will be very hard to extract.

en.headline:
Zero Escape writer says AI
could have saved his game
en.body: Kotaro Uchikoshi believes his new studio's game would not have been canceled had AI been used to cut costs.
en.mini_headline:
Uchikoshi: AI could
have saved his game

blocks.x: Kotaro Uchikoshi, known for Zero Escape and Hundred Line, insists in a new Famitsu interview that his new studio Crash Keys and its game's cancellation were real, and says that maybe the game wouldn't have been canceled if he had been allowed to use AI.

"For mid-sized teams like ours, especially those making adventure games, even indie games created by individuals could now be seen as rivals. Some of these individuals are using AI with very small teams to produce expansive games with rich content in a short time at a low cost. [...] I believe we have no choice but to use AI ourselves."

"I understand there's resistance to using AI in game development. However, personally, I am a proponent of AI." He says the origin of visual design and story must come from human ideas, but he is okay with entrusting refining and polishing to AI, which could bring a final product from 70-80 percent of a creator's vision to close to 100 percent.
Previously, Uchikoshi said Hundred Line may be "one of the last times" a game of that scale would be made without AI.

ja.headline:
Zero Escapeの作者
AIならゲームは救えた
ja.body: Uchikoshiは、AIでコストを削れていれば新作は中止されなかったと考える。

blocks.x: Zero EscapeやHundred Lineで知られるKotaro Uchikoshiは、Famitsuの新たなインタビューで、自身の新スタジオCrash Keysとそのゲームの開発中止は事実だったと強調し、AIの使用が認められていれば中止されなかったかもしれないと語った。
